Asset types

Which floating assets benefit most.

Towbot is particularly suited to assets that move infrequently, are repositioned by tugs, or require temporary propulsion for a specific project or season.

No drydock. No permanent conversion. The temporary hull attachment system is designed to be fitted and removed without drydocking, reducing downtime and the cost of the conversion process.
Discuss your fleet

Key advantages

No permanent conversion required.

The unit can be reassigned between compatible assets, reducing the capital cost of adding propulsion to a fleet of non-propelled vessels.

Flexible deployment

Reassignable

A Towbot unit can be moved between compatible assets in the fleet — one unit can serve multiple barges at different times rather than requiring a permanent installation on each.

No drydock

Waterborne fit

The temporary hull attachment system is designed to be fitted and removed without drydocking, reducing downtime and the cost of the conversion process.

Battery-electric

Zero local emissions

Battery-electric operation at the point of use — no direct exhaust emissions from the Towbot unit during manoeuvring and positioning operations.
